_comment: Mutation testing with StrykerJS: `npm run test:mutation`. Stryker changes the code in small ways (a mutant: `>=` becomes `>`, `+` becomes `-`, a condition becomes `true`) and runs the tests. A mutant that survives shows a gap in the tests.
ignorePatterns_comment: Stryker normally rewrites tsconfig.json for its sandbox with the TypeScript compiler API. TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) has no such API, so tsconfig.json is kept out of the sandbox; Vitest does not need it to run the tests.
